verdict.rationale: MotherDuck can be driven entirely without a UI. It connects through the DuckDB CLI and official SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java, plus a Postgres endpoint and an OpenAPI spec. It also runs dbt via the dbt-duckdb adapter by changing only the `path:` setting, and executes scheduled Python jobs through Flights. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (e.g. non-interactive token or service-account auth for pipelines, since the cited auth docs mention only saving credentials locally) and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
